text: As experience shows, many have been the conspiracies, but few have been successful; because he who conspires cannot act alone, nor can he take a companion except from those whom he believes to be malcontents, and as soon as you have opened your mind to a malcontent you have given him the material with which to content himself, for by denouncing you he can look for every advantage.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XIX, That one should avoid being despised and hated
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
